title: WebGPU Render Pipelines in Rust: Phong, Toon, and Wireframe
description: Compare Phong, toon, and wireframe WebGPU render pipelines in Rust and WGSL while drawing one glTF scene through three viewports with wgpu.
imageAlt: One WebGPU treasure scene shown side by side with glossy Phong shading, banded toon shading, and colored wireframe lines.
